errors.evidence: The reference description explicitly states the chart shows relative shares for the years 2014 (inner circle) and 2021 (outer circle). The machine-generated description omits the specific years and instead vaguely refers to 'öffentliche Fonds, Einrichtungen und wirtschaftlich arbeitenden Unternehmen (FEU)'.

The reference description lists all 14 categories with their exact percentage values for both 2014 and 2021, including color distinctions. The machine-generated description omits all specific category names, values, and color information.

The reference description highlights the largest segments ('Übrige' with 31.1% in 2014 and 38.1% in 2021). The machine-generated description does not mention any specific segments or their relative sizes.

The reference description notes trends such as increases (e.g., 'Stromversorgung' from 4.2% to 8.9%) and decreases (e.g., 'Abwasserentsorgung' from 10.2% to 7.8%). The machine-generated description omits all trend information.

The figure is a single ring-shaped pie chart with two concentric circles (inner and outer), not a 'doppeltes Ringdiagramm' which implies two separate rings. The reference description correctly describes it as a 'Kreisdiagramm in Ringform'.
